label: Wink at the camera
desc: A look into the camera, a playful wink with one eye, a silent laugh.
style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, natural motion
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands

beats.prompt: she looks straight into the camera, head tilting slightly to one side, a faint smile forming, breathing calmly
she winks one eye with a playful smile, eyebrow lifting, then opens the eye again and holds the smile
she laughs softly, eyes creasing, shoulders dropping as she relaxes, then settles into a warm gaze at the camera
